verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference engine and model distribution: SSD expert offload, prerouter, LoRA adapters, an OpenAI-compatible serve endpoint, and on-device apps. User-configured autonomous background automations belong to agent or workflow platforms, not inference runtimes. The macOS 'daemon' mention refers to a background serving process, not user-defined automations, so it does not make this axis applicable.
